CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2605 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d. Bus nonce: b73b5f39ce7fe45d0c7e46c26cb74ef2. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d` or `Fix review: blocked 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: b73b5f39ce7fe45d0c7e46c26cb74ef2`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2605 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2605-b73b5f39`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Delta review of PR #2605 (group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY, branch fix/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry) at head 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d. Its round-2 review returned `Fix review: merge 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864` (git fetch origin review/2605; VERDICT.md, with full evidence). Since then the orchestrator ran update_pr.sh, which merged origin/main (543c8087c, carrying roster PR #2608) and replaced the body's `## Red checks` and stale `## Head` sections, as that verdict's findings 1, 2 and 5 asked. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md; this is a resolution-delta review, not a re-review of the fix.
Required:
1. `git log --no-merges 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864..4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d ^origin/main` must list no commit outside main. Name any other commit.
2. `git diff 5a3c5d2395043b7ce9f82b383be350356c9d5864 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d` minus main's own change is empty, and the merge has no conflict resolution.
3. The body (gh pr view 2605 --json body): the round-2 findings 1, 2 and 5 are answered. `## Red checks` names pr-contract (BAD-DEST, resolved by #2608 plus this base merge) and nightly-status. The stale e0725a9ede5b paragraph is gone. Every other section is unchanged from before the update: compare with the round-2 verdict's ev/ body copy if present.
4. carry_audit.py check --body against origin/main's roster gives 0 unrouted, 0 bad. pr-contract at this head: read check-runs and report it. If it is still running, say so; it is not a block.
5. Re-run the PR's own pinned tests at the head once (the tests the round-2 verdict ran for the hb lane, e.g. tests/nightly_ha.py's self-test). They must pass on the merged tree.
6. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 4eed14bd8a6b0691235d2c9ce601aba465c93a1d must be clean. ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: b73b5f39ce7fe45d0c7e46c26cb74ef2. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
Time box 25 min.
